doc_drift.location: Edge Cases — io_uring submission queue full
doc_drift.spec_text: The actor MUST back-pressure by waiting for completions before submitting new operations.
doc_drift.actual: On ReadAsync/WriteAsync the actor surfaces SQ-push failure to the caller as an error Completion (ReadDone/WriteDone with Err(NotInitialized("io_uring submission queue full"))); it does not block/wait. This matches FR-002.
